root_cause: Third recorded occurrence of the exact same failure signature for PR #38190 (previously seen 2026-09-21T15:45:59Z run 35611485728, and 2026-09-22T12:10:20Z run 35717727822). job_llm_accuracy_tests.yml installs the locally-built 'openvino' (2026.4.1) and 'openvino_tokenizers' (2026.4.1.0) wheels via install_ov_wheels, but the following 'pip install -r tests/llm/requirements.txt' step resolves 'whowhatbench' -> 'optimum-intel[nncf,tests]' -> 'openvino-genai', pulling prebuilt 'openvino-genai-2026.4.0.0' and 'openvino-tokenizers-2026.4.0.0' wheels from the pip proxy index and silently uninstalling the just-installed local 'openvino-tokenizers-2026.4.1.0'. The prebuilt 'openvino_genai' native extension was linked against a different core 'openvino' SOVERSION (libopenvino.so.2640) than the one actually installed in this environment, so importing openvino_genai fails at pytest collection time before any test runs. The fix recommended in the first two investigations (pin/constrain openvino-genai and openvino-tokenizers, or install them from the same local artifact set) has still not been applied to job_llm_accuracy_tests.yml or tests/llm/requirements.txt.
reproduction_steps: In a fresh venv: 1) pip install <local openvino-2026.4.1 wheel> <local openvino_tokenizers-2026.4.1.0 wheel>; 2) pip install -r tests/llm/requirements.txt (pulls whowhatbench -> optimum-intel[nncf,tests] -> openvino-genai from the index, uninstalling the local openvino-tokenizers); 3) python3 -c "import openvino_genai" reproduces 'ImportError: libopenvino.so.2640: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory'.
recommended_actions: Pin/constrain 'openvino-genai' and 'openvino-tokenizers' in tests/llm/requirements.txt (or a constraints.txt) so pip cannot silently substitute the locally-built wheels for mismatched prebuilt ones during transitive resolution of whowhatbench/optimum-intel.

Install openvino-genai explicitly from the same locally-built artifact set as 'openvino'/'openvino_tokenizers' via install_ov_wheels, before running 'pip install -r tests/llm/requirements.txt', passing '--no-deps' (or an equivalent constraint) on the requirements install.

Add a fast-fail 'python3 -c "import openvino_genai"' smoke-check step immediately after wheel installation in job_llm_accuracy_tests.yml so this ABI/version mismatch surfaces clearly instead of as an opaque pytest collection error.

This is now the THIRD occurrence for the same PR across two separate merge-queue attempts and a prior run; escalate directly to the PR author/CI infra owner since the previously recommended fix has still not been applied.
prevention_strategies: Add explicit version constraints (or install-from-local-wheel steps) for openvino-genai and openvino-tokenizers in tests/llm/requirements.txt / constraints.txt so pip cannot silently substitute a mismatched prebuilt runtime during transitive dependency resolution. Add a CI smoke-import step right after wheel installation for any job that installs additional OpenVINO-dependent python packages, so ABI mismatches fail fast with a clear message instead of as an opaque pytest collection error.
historical_context: Identical failure signature (a87e95431b0e8175) was first recorded on 2026-09-21T15:45:59Z in run 35611485728, recurred on 2026-09-22T12:10:20Z in run 35717727822, and now recurs a third time on 2026-09-22T12:30:15Z in run 35719650364 - all three for PR #38190. This is the third occurrence of the same unresolved issue within roughly 21 hours; the recommended constraint/pin fix has not been applied.
